hypotheses.targeted_error_pattern: Competent but nearly redundant unit+contrast members; even selected-state argmax oracle coverage trails ordinary independent pooling. Cause not diagnosed.
hypotheses.mechanism: Clone native shared attention scoring vectors into initially equal route-owned vectors; retain shared dense value maps/BE factors and the original fixed-context objective/readout. Train from scratch.

paired_design.parameter_initialization: Private attention vectors copy the same native vector; no independent teachers or separate compression. Historical bitwise pairing not assumed.
paired_design.anchors: Complete context9 COMMON/ROUTE only when root qualifies matching/custody. No rerun or replacement of original scores.
paired_design.quality: Prospective root-owned pooled/mean-min-member/NLL decision; full-population harms and any-correct/common-rival counts. No new gate defined here.

hypotheses.interpretation: 2x2 interaction tests target-specific access to private attention, subject to optimizer-ownership and selected-development limits. COMMON improvement can be generic capacity/optimization; competent single/untied references and unused confirmation remain necessary.
hypotheses.admission: All current families complete, root finds still-useful quality question, native attention/source semantics qualified, full plan and budget frozen before fits. Not automatically activated by a positive or negative current result.
expected_failure_modes: Nuisance graph-context learning or TRAIN overfit
Shared values still miss needed evidence
Wrong confidence or introduced errors erase repairs
